mapper.select: SELECT cx.ORDER_NO, cx.EMBRYO_CODE, cx.BOM_DATA_VERSION, cx.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS6_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS7_PLAN_QTY, cx.CLASS8_PLAN_QTY, cx.MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, cx.CX_REMAIN_QTY, ci.TREAD_CODE, ci.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH, ci.TREAD_MOUTH_PLATE, ci.TREAD_RUBBER_CATEGORY FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cx LEFT JOIN T_MDM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci ON cx.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.CONSTRUCTION_CODE AND (cx.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.CONSTRUCTION_VERSION OR (cx.BOM_DATA_VERSION IS NULL AND ci.CONSTRUCTION_VERSION IS NULL)) AND ci.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE cx.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND cx.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}

SELECT final_plan.ID AS MONTH_PLAN_ID, final_plan.PRODUCTION_NO, final_plan.FACTORY_CODE, #{experimentPlanDate} AS EXPERIMENT_PLAN_DATE, final_plan.${dayColumn} AS DAY_QTY, final_plan.EMBRYO_CODE, final_plan.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, construction_info.TREAD_CODE, construction_info.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH, construction_info.TREAD_MOUTH_PLATE, construction_info.TREAD_RUBBER_CATEGORY FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL final_plan LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_info.* FROM ( SELECT ci.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.CONSTRUCTION_CODE ORDER BY ci.UPDATE_TIME DESC, ci.ID DESC) AS rn FROM T_MDM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci WHERE ci.IS_DELETE = 0 ) ranked_info WHERE ranked_info.rn = 1 ) construction_info ON final_plan.EMBRYO_CODE = construction_info.CONSTRUCTION_CODE WHERE final_plan.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND final_plan.YEAR_MONTH = #{yearMonth} AND final_plan.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = '01' AND final_plan.IS_DELETE = 0 AND final_plan.${dayColumn} > 0 ORDER BY final_plan.PRODUCTION_SEQUENCE, final_plan.ID
